RaceName: Ladbrokes "Bet £5 Get £30 New Customer Offer" EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Made the frame in 7f Musselburgh handicap in June but has not been firing on all cylinders this year and is not yet proven over 1m.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
OwnerName: Mrs C Clark D Pollitt & Mrs E Quinlan

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Ten-time winner; on the downgrade now but fairly consistent in handicaps in recent months; went without her usual cheekpieces on last two outings; big player in this grade if first-time visor has any positive effect.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
OwnerName: N J Dalgarno & W R Ellis
Spotlight: Beaten only by a short head and a nose when third in similar C&D race to this last month and also ran well when second at Newcastle (1m, AW) ten days ago, but his 0-29 strike-rate is not easily overlooked.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won two 7f AW handicaps in September, but recent turf form has been disappointing and he's now 0-25 on this surface.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Did not get competitive over C&D on seasonal/handicap debut a fortnight ago, but remains unexposed after only four runs and is worth a glance in the betting.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Not disgraced when fifth of 13 in this grade at Newcastle (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) last month, but has now been unplaced all eight starts; back up in trip for turf return; improvement required.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Showed no significant promise in three novice races in June (7f-1m2f) but has a more realistic chance to get competitive in this basement-grade contest.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Stayed on for fourth off basement mark on seasonal/handicap debut at Carlisle (1m, soft) in May, but her well-held third at Musselburgh (1m, good) the following month was a backward step; others look stronger.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Unplaced all nine starts, most recently when tailed off in this grade here (1m2f, good) on Saturday; drops back in trip with cheekpieces refitted.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Kevin Costello And Jane & Andrew Black
Spotlight: Third foal; out of a Listed-placed 1m5f winner (RPR 101) and sister to 1m 2yo/12.4f winner Gallifrey; longer trips will suit in time but Saffie Osborne is booked; her yard's first 2yo runner of the season, along with stablemate Rhythm Of My Heart.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 32,000gns breeze-up buy; by Blue Point; first foal; out of an unraced half-sister to winners Dubai Harbour (1m2f) and Passive Management (US 1m1f); yard is 0-4 with 2yos this season but she might be happier over this trip than some with stouter pedigrees.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to 1m AW winner Queen Leila (RPR 62); dam 1m6f Flat (62) and 2m hurdle winner; in a powerful yard so the betting should be instructive.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Born in Southern Hemisphere in February 2024; second foal; out of a French 1m3f winner, closely related to French 1m4f Listed winner Sacred Spirit; breeding suggests she might be one for further down the line.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Cxxi And Pls
Spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Preanka (RPR 77); dam unraced sister to French 1m2f Listed winner Tresorerie; it's not ideal for a newcomer to be drawn widest over 7f here.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 32,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f winner Fast Society (RPR 92); dam unraced sister to 11.6f winner Nathania; stable's 2yos 1-18 this season and a watching brief makes sense.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Trinquette (French 7f/1m; RPR 100), Candonomore (7f/1m; 88) and Tilak (French 8.5f AW); dam French 7f AW 2yo winner (93); trainer doesn't have many 2yos go in at the first time of asking.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; half-sister to 1m2f winner Huggable (RPR 75); dam placed 1m/8.6f AW (70), out of Australian 6f-winning close relative of New Zealand 7f Group 1/Australian 1m Group 2 winner Tavistock; nice pedigree so worth checking in the betting, especially with her yard doubly represented.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; twelfth foal; half-sister to five winners including Pursuing The Dream (French 5f 2yo Listed; RPR 100), Izlaz (French Listed-placed 1m/8.5f; 96) and He's A Laddie (5f AW 2yo; 85); dam maiden half-sister to Listed winners at 6f and 1m2f; best watched unless backed.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 2,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Dudley's Boy (1m-1m2f; RPR 88), Lunanova (1m; 72), Gyenyame (Flat/hurdle/chase winner) and Saorla (7f AW; 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (89); others appeal more on paper.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 14,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to 1m4f/1m6f Flat (RPR 90) and 2m hurdle winner St Pancras; dam 1m2f-1m6f winner (109); appeals as one who might do better over longer trips next season but needs checking in the betting; one of two runners for this yard.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
OwnerName: W H & Mrs J A Tinning & Mrs C Wallis
Spotlight: Ended a long losing run when scoring off 2lb lower at Carlisle (1m, soft) last June; has had just two runs this season but she's run creditably in a handicap and a seller at Beverley; now drops back in trip but has possibilities if she gets a good pace and some luck.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Started this year with a 5f win at Newcastle (Tapeta) but he's been disappointing since and was beaten 7l at Newcastle (1m) last month; has plenty to prove and he needs a major revival back in trip; tongue-tie reapplied.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner but his last success was in May 2024 and he's not finished closer than fifth in his seven runs this season; needs to find more back up in trip.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't won on turf for more than three years but he's run plenty of good races this season including when runner-up over C&D (good to firm) in May and close third at Hamilton (6f, good to soft) in June; hasn't made an impact in last two runs but this drop back in trip is a positive and he's in the mix.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has form figures of 89778 in handicaps and was laboured at Redcar (7f, good) when last seen in June; mark continues to fall but he needs a transformation after a short break.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: His last win was at Southwell in April 2024 but he travelled strongly for a long way before weakening there (7f) last month; record of 1-35 on turf but he's on a much lower mark back in this sphere and is well handicapped on his best form last season; one to keep an eye on with visor reapplied.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time course winner (7f/1m) who acts on good to firm and good to soft; did well to finish a close third after missing the break at Hamilton (8.3f) nine days ago but he's not easy to predict and was always behind over C&D on Saturday night; risks attached.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins at Musselburgh last summer and she returned to form with a creditable second behind her stablemate there (7f, good) on Friday; this is a deeper race but her last win was off a higher mark and she has won at Ayr in the past; respected.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who has finished close up in handicaps here in her last two starts; gave it a good shot from the front over C&D two weeks ago and she's still unexposed after only six runs; respected off 1lb lower than last time.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough with cheekpieces added at Redcar (7f, good) in May and he backed that up with a close third of 15 at Doncaster; struggled at Chester last time but that was from a wide draw and he ran into a handicap blot who won by 8l; has possibilities if he can bounce back and he's still unexposed at this trip.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins since cheekpieces were added last autumn and her last success was at Carlisle (7f, soft) in June; didn't shine at Doncaster (good to firm) last time but that was over 1m and she still looks on a workable mark; dangerous back in trip.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has been beaten 15l in two handicaps here (6f, good/good to firm) this season; mark is tumbling but he has a lot to prove with cheekpieces added at this new trip; one of three runners for the yard.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 45,000euros breeze-up buy; first foal; out of an unraced sister to winners Harlem Nights (7f/1m) and Joolianoss (1m/1m2f); others appeal as more likely winners.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 45,000euros yearling; seventh foal; closely related to French Listed-placed 1m AW winner Around The World (RPR 96); dam unplaced 7f/1m in France, half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Carry On Katie; stable's 2yos are 5-21 on the AW this year; considered.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bought at the breeze-ups for £25,000; half-brother to Italian 6f AW 2yo winner Slide To Glory; dam placed 5.5f-7f in France; stable's newcomers are usually best watched unless backed.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; out of a 1m AW 2yo winner (sole start; RPR 69), out of unraced sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Bogart and half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Blaine; already gelded but it makes sense to check the betting vibes.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 40,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Coconut Cove (Listed-placed 6f AW 2yo; RPR 98) and Serenity Dream (6f/7f; 84); dam 6f AW winner (73), closely related to 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Charming Thought; nicely bred, from a strong 2yo yard and well drawn.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Timiko (1m3f Oaks D'Italia; RPR 103), Aqpan (7f AW; 96) and Batraan (5f/6f; 82); dam unraced sister to 7f/1m 2yo winner Codicil; has been gelded and drawn wide.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 28,000gns breeze-up buy in April; second foal; dam placed 1m2f (RPR 75), sister to useful 10.6f winner Tartlette; one to note in the betting.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to winners Show Yourself (5f; RPR 92), Yabrave (6f; 91), Engelbert (7f AW; 84) and Dream Painter (Italian 5.5f-1m1f); dam 7f 2yo winner (87); stable's 2yos are 0-19 this campaign.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 6,500gns yearling; second foal; dam placed 6f-9.4f AW (RPR 74), sister to 5f winner Raahy; one of two from this yard.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Eighth foal; half-brother to five winners including Heathcliff (Listed-placed 6f/7f AW; RPR 108), Isola Rossa (7f/1m; 94) and Glory Fighter (prolific 5f; 90); dam 6f winner (71), half-sister to smart 5f/6f winner Mazzini; has been gelded; drawn wide but some positives in his pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 26,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to 7f AW winner White Crown Star (RPR 85); dam unraced half-sister to winners Eleonora Duse (1m2f Group 2) and Scottish Stage (1m2f Listed; runner-up in Irish Oaks); one of only two fillies in the field but still one to bear in mind given her yard and pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; out of a 1m2f/1m3f winner (RPR 69), half-sister to useful winners Snow Master (7f/1m) and Auld Toon Lune (1m2f); hails from strong yard but disconcerting to see headgear on from the outset.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Right back on song with second of 18 at York (1m2f) in June but only fifth of eight at Southwell (1m3f) since; needs to bounce back if he's to double his tally here.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways in 1m5f handicap at Hamilton last month; this C&D scorer needs considering in refitted cheekpieces (won in them here) nudged up 1lb.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Enjoying a fine year and garnered a sixth success in ten-runner handicap over C&D in June; freshened up since and remains handily weighted despite a 5lb rise; big shout.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Started out for current yard with encouraging Redcar sixth in June but he has failed to build on it in a pair of 1m Newcastle handicaps since; needs to take a step forward.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: C&D winner last summer; back in good form of late and posted a solid fifth of eight in 1m2f Doncaster handicap last month; in the mix once more.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Fair ex-Irish maiden who signed off for Johnny Murtagh with a good second of ten in 1m2f maiden at Ballinrobe in June; since changed hands for 48,000gns and not out of things for in-form yard.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Already a dual winner for current yard, going in over C&D in July; posted another solid effort with fourth of five over C&D last time; can't be discounted.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: A fair 1m4f winner for Ed Walker in 2025; off ten months and failed to beat a rival on her yard debut in 1m5f handicap here four weeks ago; cheekpieces are reached for now.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Scored four times here (three over C&D) in 2025; yet to fire this season however and never threatened when sixth of nine over 1m here three weeks ago.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
OwnerName: HM The King & HM The Queen
Spotlight: Lope De Vega gelding who resumed from five months off to land 7.5f maiden at Beverley in June; suffered a poor run on his handicap debut when fourth of five at Sandown (1m) 17 days ago and remains capable of better; likely player.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
OwnerName: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing
Spotlight: Winless since 2024 and this veteran has yet to fire in handicaps over C&D and at Newcastle (1m4f) this summer; others appeal more.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Gained a first win in 7f Southwell handicap in November but he has failed to kick on subsequently and beat just two in 7f Wolverhampton handicap last time; retried in a hood here.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Fair maiden for Ed Walker; made a winning start for new yard in five-runner maiden at Windsor (1m2f) two weeks ago; not out of things back in handicap company, although yard also has Star Cast in here.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Disappointing favourite when only third of four at Catterick last month but he went close on nursery debut at Leicester (also 7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) two starts ago and has good claims if benefiting from the combination of new trip, switch to AW and first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well down the field in three 6f novice races and seemingly on a tough mark for this nursery debut; needs the step up in trip to unlock significant improvement.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Placed on last three appearances, most recently when third in 7f Lingfield maiden on AW debut on Tuesday; upped in trip for this nursery debut; ought to be very competitive again.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Appeared to show improvement when sixth of seven in 6f Windsor novice a fortnight ago, on third start, but almost certainly needs to kick on again over this new trip on his nursery debut.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Displayed minor promise on last two outings, more recently when fourth of seven at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) last month; ought to be suited by this longer trip on this nursery debut; a possible.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Six-race maiden; seems to have some quirks but was beaten under 1l when third in recent Ffos Las nursery (7.3f, good); upped in trip for this AW return; could have a say.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well down the field in his three qualifying races in the spring (5f-7f); makes nursery debut from a basement mark but still needs to take a big step forward; recently gelded.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Nearly 6l behind Magical Life when fifth of ten on recent nursery debut at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) and only 1lb better off with her here; upped in trip and fitted with blinkers for AW debut; clearly needs to improve.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed no promise and was beaten at least 17l on his first three appearances (6f-7f); upped in trip and fitted with first-time visor for this nursery debut.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: On a losing run but he made a good start for new yard (formerly with Stephen Hanlon) with second of 12 in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 11 days ago; up 2lb but not taken lightly.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Back to winning ways at Wolverhampton (5f) in April and largely in good form subsequently, third of eight in 5f handicap here two week ago; can make his presence felt eased 1lb.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Modest maiden for Kieran Cotter in Ireland; off over three months before posting an encouraging fifth of nine on yard debut in 5f Catterick handicap 26 days ago, running on late; a player with that run under his belt.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Failed to build on earlier promise with fifth of 14 in 6f Doncaster handicap in June; more is needed if he's to double his tally here.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods
Spotlight: On a long losing sequence and yet to hit top form this season, fourth of nine in 6f Thirsk handicap nine days ago; more is required despite a falling mark.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Arrives out of sorts, tried in cheekpieces when last of nine in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 27 days ago; visor is tried here.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: A dual 6f/7f AW winner in 2025; only eighth of 12 in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 11 days ago, and she's not proving easy to catch right this season.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a second success of 2026 at Hamilton (6f) in July; came in last of eight over 5f here a fortnight later, though, and was also disappointing over C&D on Saturday.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark at Newcastle (6f) in April but her recent form is not so encouraging, tenth of 12 in 5f handicap there ten days ago; hood goes on now.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Scored over C&D (fifth course victory) in July and not discredited with fourth of six in 5f classified event at Wolverhampton ten day ago; very much one to consider back here.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: Posted a good third over 5f here in June but she's beaten just one rival in two subsequent outings at Hamilton and back here; this course scorer needs to take a big step forward.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
Spotlight: It's now 24 starts since his last victory though he shaped as if the run was needed after five months off when eighth of ten in 6f Wolverhampton handicap last month; needs to build on it.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner
Spotlight: Got back on track with third of seven to Doon The Glen in 6f Hamilton handicap 25 days ago; she needs to back it up now if she's to double her career tally.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: No good thing to confirm last month's course placings with Fallacious Promise and was found wanting off this 5lb higher mark at Yarmouth since; however, he's heading the right way and Luke Catton claims 3lb.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Successful handicap debut at Doncaster in the spring (7f, good to firm) but hasn't been close to that level since; moves up to 1m for the first time.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Placed three times, including when a close second in a 7f handicap here on reappearance; that was an improved effort and she's just 2lb higher now.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Failed to progress in his qualifying runs and his hopes are pinned on first-time blinkers sparking improvement now switching to a handicap.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Absent for 79 days but he was returning from 223 days off when runner-up on handicap debut at Windsor (1m; made the running); that was his best form yet and he could improve again.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Left Brian Meehan for 14,000gns; now a nine-race maiden after finishing last of five on yard debut at Leicester (1m).

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: 1m AW win in France in March; three heavy defeats in handicaps for this yard (6f-1m) before another one in claiming company.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
OwnerName: I Foster, D Fish, W Dale & S Dale
Spotlight: Twice runner-up as 2yo (6f); made some return to form after wind surgery when beaten 3l at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) where he got behind before running on; this extra furlong could benefit.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Has progressed with each run and she was keeping on when close up over 7f at Southwell (AW); this trip should suit on handicap debut and one to bear in mind.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
OwnerName: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub
Spotlight: 7f maiden winner at Chester; 0-5 in handicaps and when second there last month he was beaten 8l; beat one home at Sandown subsequently; not wildly appealing.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Has placed form but below par in her last two races and she's now 0-10; others preferred.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent gelding who won well at Lingfield (1m, AW) and with a clear run he might well have followed up off 6lb higher over C&D a month ago (beaten by Roi De Coeur); up another 4lb but he was clear of the third last time and looks a good bet to give his running.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Owned by former trainer Andrew Balding; ran to an ordinary level for him and went in a hood when last seen in March; has much to prove after a break on handicap debut.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Failed to progress from her debut run (5f, AW) in three further starts for James Tate; sold for 3,400gns in May and was down the field on stable debut here (first-time hood).

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won on soft ground in the autumn and ran big race in defeat on reappearance outing at Haydock (1m3f, good to soft) in the spring, but disappointed on his next outing (again raced too freely) and is not easy to predict.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Scored over extended 1m4f on Tapeta in January and probably found 8.6f too sharp on that surface last month, after a break; should be fine back on turf but others have more persuasive profiles all the same.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Has modest 2-31 strike-rate but scores good marks for her consistency in recent months, having made the frame five consecutive times (once over C&D); probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Did well for new stable last season, winning three times over 1m at Ripon; also suited by 1m2f, but launched this campaign with two low-key runs (7f/1m) and needs a good boost from the new cheekpieces.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won twice off marks slightly higher than today's last season (1m3f/1m4f) and was seemingly back in good nick when running-on fourth over C&D (good) last month, but suffered heavy defeat on AW 16 days ago and has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won three times over 1m here last season; yet to hit top gear this year but was placed over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago and remains well handicapped; dangerous to ignore.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
OwnerName: A Sinclair, I Jardine & V Renwick
Spotlight: Largely consistent hurdler who returned to the Flat with respectable fourth (just behind Penelope's Sister) over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; 1lb lower today and might be better suited by the slightly slower ground; each-way claims at least.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: In good form this year, most recently when coming from the rear for C&D (good) success five weeks ago; subsequent 3lb rise is offset by Jack Nicholls' claim today; likely contender again.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 12-race maiden who has basically been disappointing this season (four runs; 6f-1m); moves up in trip with quite a bit to prove.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Regressive mare who was badly out of form when last seen in the autumn; needs to have been revitalised by subsequent break, and could be considered only if attracting market support.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; kept on for third of six at Hamilton (8.3f, good; wore cheekpieces) last month but safely held on AW since; sports first-time blinkers for first attempt at 1m2f; others appeal more.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 11-race maiden who has finished well down the field on all three appearances this season, most recently when 100-1 over C&D (good; first-time cheekpieces) last month.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Competitive without winning for James Tate, whom she left for 6,000gns; ran well on her previous visit to this track and not without hope.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Old Gold Racing, Tim Cottier & Partner
Spotlight: 0-12 but has proved herself capable off higher marks than today's and ran second over 1m2f at Nottingham 11 days ago; kept on well that day and goes up in trip here; considered.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 1m2f winner on ground slower than good; has performed just okay since returning from a break and whether she wants quite this far is open to debate.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden whose best effort was a third of 13 at Goodwood (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June 2025; opposable on subsequent AW exploits (visored in the last two races) and she's been off since February.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in her first three races (1m2f/1m3f), the latest over C&D; however, she's well bred and should be a different proposition now handicapping at a lowly level.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Disappointing last time but realistically treated for this handicap debut on her two initial efforts (1m2f); AW debut.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Struggled at big prices in her qualifying runs and this initial mark looks on the high side unless she can find major improvement.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced filly who has been beaten 4l (extended 1m3f) and 2l (1m2f) in her two handicaps; has dropped 3lb and Harry Vigors now takes off another 5lb with his claim; should go well.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Has won two of her four handicaps (the wins at 1m2f) and attempted to bite her rider's stick last time at Sandown, losing some focus in the process; she wouldn't have won but could have been closer; just 1lb higher now.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 1m2f winner on turf in May when 6lb lower; solid runs in defeat since then, latterly over an extended 1m3f when Hot Silk was back in fourth; hasn't been as good on the AW (0-5) but perhaps unwise to count that against her.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Front-runner; started off for new stable with two down-the-field runs over 1m in the spring, but fared much better when third at Carlisle (1m3f, good to soft) in June and remains on a good mark.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: In-form 5yo who won twice over C&D last month (good/good to firm); probably doesn't have much margin for error after latest 4lb rise but ought to be on the premises again.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Bounced back to form with win off much-reduced mark at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in April and came second on his next two outings; not seen to best effect when held up in steadily run race at Chester last month, but has quickly dropped back to a workable mark; high on the list.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Yet to win this season but came from quite a long way off the pace for clear second at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last month and remains on a workable mark; has possibilities if this race is run to suit.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Slow to find his form this season, but his keeping-on third behind Royal Blaze over C&D (good) last month was a big step back in the right direction and he might be seen to even better effect if there's a stronger pace for him to chase today; sports first-time cheekpieces; interesting.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 12-race maiden; didn't run badly when sixth over C&D (good to firm; first run after wind op) three weeks ago and continues to slip down the weights, but needs to find something extra today.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Veteran who led close home over 1m5f here (good to firm) last month, his 13th success; also suited by this shorter trip, but was effectively 3lb below that last winning mark when only fourth over C&D a week later and his new mark has taken effect; younger rivals look better treated.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo; just a respectable fourth of six on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last month but could quite plausibly still have potential.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Unable to land a telling blow in his first three handicaps (7f-1m1f); in good hands and not written off just yet, but others in this line-up have much more obvious claims.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; ran fairly well when upped to 1m2f on Tapeta in February but we haven't seen him since; gelded in April; considered only if lively in the betting.

RaceName: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Made encouraging stable/handicap debut when fifth at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) in June, but two lesser efforts have followed and he arrives here with something to prove.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Won at up to almost 2m5f as hurdler so he's a strong stayer; back to the Flat with two wins on good ground (Ascot and Chester) and another on AW at Newcastle in winning the 20-runner Northumberland Vase; up another 5lb (Luke Catton's claim eases 3lb of that) but has track form and strongly considered.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Both wins came in 2022 when trained in France; returning to the Flat for the first time this year when the race was voided at Wolverhampton; he was 50-1 that day.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Close up in his one previous run on the AW; dual turf winner on heavy ground over 1m4f and 1m6f; beaten 5l by an exposed 8yo last time at Goodwood (2m, soft) having been clear at one stage; has a big run in him.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Has turned things around with wins at Southwell (1m6f) and Lingfield (1m5f), latterly defying a penalty by one length; the 4lb rise could find him out in this higher grade and Jack Callan, who was aboard for those wins, no longer claims.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Record of 6-25 on turf but 0-10 on the AW; this year started off okay but after predictably struggling in a Group 3 she's disappointed in a couple of handicaps; needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Did well in 2024 and then had 592 days off the track; signs of rediscovering his form when 4l behind Believitanducan in the Northumberland Vase (2m AW); dropped 3lb and in the mix.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: 1m6f and 2m wins on the AW last season and by clear daylight; excellent third at Newmarket (1m4f) after a break and it wasn't a bad run at Sandown (1m6f) where he hung in the closing stages; could be a factor if bringing his best game.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Had a productive year over hurdles and on the Flat, last time returning from a break and boxing on for second at Sandown (1m6f); he was bang there over C&D the time before; solid chance.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Six AW wins include two here and it was at this venue where he was headed late on over C&D a month ago; he did have the run of things up front that day, though.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Pulled up in successive handicap hurdles before beaten about 11l in a 2m handicap at Chester; has a bit to prove, but encouraging that best Flat form has been on this surface.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive AW form (1m-1m4f) and took a strong hold when fourth of six on handicap debut at Doncaster (1m6f); there should be more to come from him.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)
Spotlight: 1m4f novice winner; 11-4 or shorter when runner-up in her last three handicaps, the latest here when headed late on in first-time cheekpieces; it could be she was in front early enough (travelled well) but unwise to keep making excuses; nudged up 2lb.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester (1m, good to firm) in June, but struggled at York next time before being well held at Beverley 13 days ago; record is now 1-8 and others are more convincing.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Her standout effort in three 2yo runs was a close call on soft ground at Beverley (8.4f) on her second start; returns after 293 days off but she should have more to offer now switched to a handicap and it would be a positive if the forecast rain arrives; needs a close look in the market.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Finished well to go close on handicap debut at Southwell (7f, AW) in April and he backed that up with a creditable third at Musselburgh (1m, good); returns after 120 days off but he's still unexposed and that latest form has been well advertised by the runner-up since; respected.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Newcastle novice (1m, AW) in December but she was vulnerable switched to handicaps in her final two runs for Harry Charlton; changed hands for 22,000gns in April; still lightly raced but she needs resume her progress after 117 days off.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough with a visor added when finishing well to land a Catterick handicap (7f, good to firm; 18-1) last month; up 3lb but he still looks feasibly treated on that latest form and is open to more progress back up in trip; key player.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she returned to form with a win at Haydock (1m, good to soft) in May and backed that up with a good second at Ripon (1m, good) the following month; now goes back up in grade but she's respected off same mark as last time.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed gelding but he's not really progressed and was a well-held sixth behind Wise Crack at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last time; others preferred.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Reached the frame in her first three handicaps but her form has gone in the wrong direction in two runs this summer; may have been stretched when upped to 1m2f here last time but she's now 0-8 and others are more persuasive.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Came good with wins at Beverley (8.4f) and Thirsk (1m, again on good to firm) last month and had an excuse in his hat-trick bid at Southwell (suffered interference) two weeks ago; only 2lb higher than for his last success and he could kick on again back on turf.

RaceName: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap
Spotlight: Has a good pedigree but struggled in three novice events, most recently when tailed off on Wetherby reappearance in June; still early days but he needs a transformation on his handicap debut.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-brother to Arizona to a Scandinavian Flat/hurdles winner; dam unraced; best watched.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Jumped poorly and pulled up at Limerick on debut; tailed off in the Killarney race in which Minella Buoy was second.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed on the Flat at Roscommon last year and twice on AW earlier this year; held by Minella Buoy and No Bother Aoife on running over hurdles at Killarney.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beat very few rivals in three Flat maidens last year; sixth of 14 on Flat handicap debut at Gowran; stepped up on his modest Flat form when second on hurdles debut at Killarney, solid chance

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Third foal; Sioux Nation gelding is a brother to a Polish 7f winner, half-brother to Polish 1m 2yo winner; dam, by Wootton Bassett, French 1m 2yo winner, half-sister to Flat/hurdle/chase winner Fast Buck.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Modest Flat form for Donnacha O'Brien; will need to step up from hurdling debut at Hexham; third in a six-runner, the second has won two small-field events since then.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed some ability on the Flat, rated 65, made the frame in two handicaps; split Sofi's Gift and Words Unspoken when third at Limerick on hurdles debut.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Fair 75-rated maiden on the Flat; interesting juvenile hurdle prospect on pedigree, being a half-brother to useful jumpers Puturhandstogether and Showurappreciation.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Not far behind Sofi's Guest and Nicky Larson at Limerick; has more to find with Minella Buoy, No Bother Aoife and Divelment on Killarney running.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 61-rated maiden on the Flat; has questions to answer after his two most recent starts, last of eight at Leopardstown and seventh of nine at this venue; coming from this source, quite possible she will improve considerably for the switch to jumping.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Rated 51 on the Flat after seven runs; fair fourth on hurdles debut at Killarney but looks held by runner-up Minella Buoy.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Second at this track in June was the highlight of her Flat form; disappointing when favourite at Gowran last time; hooded now.

RaceName: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weak Flat form; overcame some interference to finish a promising second on hurdles debut at Limerick; has an edge over Nicky Larson and Words Unspoken; stable in great form with a treble at Kilbeggan on Saturday.

RaceName: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: P Afia, E Hobson, A Pegley, C&r Russell
Spotlight: Looked as good as ever when scoring in good style on seasonal debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in April but subsequent efforts, though respectable, suggest she's a shade vulnerable off her current mark.

RaceName: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent 6yo who was placed at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) last month and remains 1lb lower than when scoring over C&D (good to firm) just over a year ago; ought to be right in the thick of things.

RaceName: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: W Trenchard, A Coupland, Cheam Marketng
Spotlight: Pretty consistent on the Flat and over hurdles this year and has dropped 1lb since his recent fourth at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm); visor (worn for last four races) is left off here; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Ought to be suited by combination of drop back in trip and return to turf, but has not been firing on all cylinders this season and has a lot more to prove than some of these.

RaceName: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who justified odds-on favouritism when scoring on handicap debut at Ffos Las (1m, good; front pair clear) on Tuesday; bred to be suited by today's step up in trip and probably still well treated under 6lb penalty; makes obvious appeal.

RaceName: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) in June and was close third off today's mark at Epsom (1m2f, good) last month; needs to bounce back from a lesser effort a fortnight later but still enters calculations.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Four wins in Britain, best on AW; reached a peak rating of 85 after two Kempton wins last year; not at his best in recent months; however, he is race-fit and the bar is set low for his hurdles debut; interesting.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Some promise in points for Rob James; hard to be confident after a poor bumper run at Downpatrick on his first start for Gordon Elliott.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Brian M Keenan & P W Mullins
Spotlight: Started favourite for a Roscommon bumper last August, well beaten, found to be blowing hard; raced keenly when again a beaten favourite at Tramore in October, very tame effort on hurdles debut at Sligo last month; tongue-tie on now; trainer also runs How's Ellie.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weak overall form in points after debut third; in rear in a Kilbeggan bumper in June.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Hillstar gelding whose dam (by Beneficial) won a bumper and a maiden hurdle.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soundly beaten when fourth of five finishers in a point; positives in the pedigree; brother to bumper winner Getaway Vic, half-brother to hurdle/chase winner Lightkeeper; dam bumper and useful hurdle/chase winner.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: John Henry & William Bates & Paul Hillis
Spotlight: Fair bumper form last year for Ronnie O'Leary; mildly encouraging hurdles debut for new yard at Downpatrick; will not need to improve much from his Kilbeggan fourth to feature here; cheekpieces added

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soldier Of Fortune gelding; half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Harty Cup; dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful chase winner Sraid Padraig; Never involved first time out at Kilbeggan, likely to need more experience, in good hands.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up in maiden hurdles at Limerick and Galway, massive odds on both occasions.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weak form in bumpers and over hurdles; big price when a remote fifth at Limerick in May.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten favourite but not a bad run in first bumper at Galway last October, beaten 9l in fifth; not as good next time at Tramore; unfancied when a moderate sixth on hurdles debut at Roscommon; still looked raw when second at this venue last month; capable of picking up a modest race.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Two runs at Sligo, pulled up in a maiden hurdle and tailed off in a bumper.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: No encouragement can be taken from her bumper runs at Limerick and Sligo.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Remote sixth on her only point-to-point start; some positives in the pedigree, sister to a bumper/chase winner, half-sister to two other winners.

RaceName: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Reported to be blowing after her debut at Ballinrobe, a long way behind How's Ellie then; probably capable of much better, needs to provide reassurance.

RaceName: Fitzdares Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Thames Boys, J Henwood & J Clay
Spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when emphatic winner of C&D (good to firm) novice in first-time cheekpieces a fortnight ago and has the services of Oisin Murphy again for this nursery debut; commands respect.

RaceName: Fitzdares Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on well to make winning nursery debut over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; subsequent 5b rise demands more from him but he still needs to be taken very seriously.

RaceName: Fitzdares Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Showed similar level of form in all three novice races, most recently when close second at Ffos Las (6f, good) six weeks ago; gelded in the meantime; open to improvement in nurseries.

RaceName: Fitzdares Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Won two quite valuable sellers (both 6f, good) this spring, but was soundly beaten after racing too freely on recent nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm); in calmer waters here and may benefit from the drop back in trip, but others have more convincing claims.

RaceName: Fitzdares Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: The Lamb Inn Wantage Racing Team
Spotlight: Won Bath maiden (5.7f, firm) by wide margin in May, but was last of six after refusing to settle in C&D nursery won by Keep Kicking On three weeks ago; now has a point to prove.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a bumper and two hurdles for Declan Queally; yet to hit form for this stable; pulled up at Downpatrick in June; visor on now.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner in 2023 and also recorded two Flat wins for Tony Martin; won a Kilbeggan handicap on stable debut in May, when returning from a 214-day break; failed to back that up at Killarney last month.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner; possible to excuse his handicap hurdle debut at Tramore; ran respectably in a Flat maiden here three weeks ago.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Cheekpieces on now after a below-par Sligo run last week; respectable form before that, fourth in races at Clonmel and Sligo.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Roscommon bumper winner a year ago for Andy Slattery; may find his level now after three maiden hurdle runs; needs to settle better.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Shock winner at Cork in April (2m, yielding); mid-field off revised mark at Limerick later that month, when testing ground may not have suited; unplaced favourite in a novice contest at Downpatrick; moderate run at this venue last month, jumped untidily at times.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flashes of form over hurdles and fences during a light campaign in 2025; first run since March; not one of the more obvious contenders.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won 2m1f Clonmel handicap in April (yielding); has been kept busy; second over 2m1f at Wexford, fair third behind Max Meridius over a slightly longer trip at this venue; needs to bounce back from a poor run at Cork last week.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six wins on the Flat; no sign of an equivalent standard in six starts over hurdles, the most recent at this venue in May.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan bumper in 2023; has struggled over hurdles after two lengthy absences; tailed off at Wexford in May, same at this venue on her only 2025 start.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Left modest maiden form behind to run a fine race when second on handicap debut at Clonmel in May; showed a similar standard of form when runner-up at Killarney; both those races have been over further, and this trip might not be ideal; holds a leading chance all the same.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 200-1 bumper winner at the 2024 Galway festival; no sign of winning potential over hurdles at this stage; 50-1 when pulled up here in May.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles at Thurles (2m) and Cork (2m4f) late last year; 2026 form is less persuasive, though the form of his Sligo fourth was boosted significantly by the winner Timurshah in winning twice at the Galway festival.

RaceName: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Took a long time to win a race over hurdles but has been in fine form in recent months; deserved her breakthrough win at Kilbeggan; suffered interference when chasing home an easy winner at Limerick; transferred her form to the Flat when second at 25-1 in a 1m4f contest at the same venue; good chance off a light weight.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Mehmas colt who finished well for a last-gasp debut win over C&D (good to firm) last month; pulled almost 4l clear with the runner-up in that race and he should improve for that experience; strongly respected under a penalty.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made all for a comfortable win on Wetherby debut (5.5f, good to firm) in June and she built on that when going very close under a penalty at Newbury (6f, good to firm) 19 days later; sets a good standard on that form and she could be hard to catch.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; gelded brother to winners Nordic Glory (prolific 5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 77) and A Lott Of Kane (5f/6f AW; 58); dam 5f 2yo winner (76), sister to 6.5f Listed winner Princedargent and useful 1m-1m2f winner Erik The Red; this looks a tough starting point and he's best watched.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Weak 11-1 shot and he ran green before finishing a remote last of nine at Salisbury (5f, good) in May; returns after a break and he needs a transformation upped in trip on his second start.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 100,000euros yearling, 45,000euros breeze-up 2yo; Mehmas half-brother to three winners, notably Gavota (Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo; RPR 105); dam unraced; has good target to aim at on debut and market should guide.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished down the field on Bath debut (5.7f, firm) last month and he was beaten 19l when last of five at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last time.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Promising effort at Down Royal in his first handicap; two slightly less encouraging runs since, both at Wexford; fair chance in this grade with 5lb claimed.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Out of his depth in a Flat maiden at Galway; struggled at Killarney in his first handicap hurdle, last of 15.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Progressive handicap hurdler in March/April; won over 2m5f at Down Royal (yielding) and better again off 11lb higher when clear second over 2m4f at Limerick; questions to answer after his last two starts, one of which was over fences.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three wins on the Flat; 1-18 over hurdles, with that sole success coming in this race two years ago; had a long layoff before returning at Limerick early last month, struggling when unseating rider three out.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle over a furlong further here last month, with Le Diablo back in third; last week's Cork run looked too bad to be true.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in a maiden last summer; improved considerably from her first handicap at Listowel when second at Roscommon five weeks ago; beaten 7l but did well to recover from interference which caused her to become unbalanced before three out.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Promising second handicap attempt when chasing home a 6l winner in a 20-runner 2m Cork contest in April, having made much of the running; possible excuse for a poor Wexford run in May, hampered by a loose horse and may have lost confidence.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club
Spotlight: Potentially well handicapped relative to her best chase form; good form in that sphere last October when backing up a Sligo win with seconds at Tramore and Down Royal; might need the run, her first since out of her depth in a Grade 2 mares' chase at Cork last December; 13lb lower than her chase mark

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner ran her best race over hurdles when a distant third of 14 on handicap hurdle debut at Downpatrick (2m2f, good); has produced two much less encouraging displays since then.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A couple of encouraging efforts last season after returning from a long absence, notably when fifth of 24 at Cork (2m4f, soft to heavy); soundly beaten when filling the same place at Kilbeggan in April.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back-to-back winner in staying handicaps at Gowran and Listowel for Emmet Mullins in May/June 2023; has run infrequently in recent years; has struggled in three runs for this yard.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Badly out of form over hurdles before a satisfactory chase debut at Limerick in May; others are more appealing.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed six times on the Flat; relatively unexposed over hurdles; needs to find extra judged on his handicap attempts at Wexford and Cork.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner has run creditably in defeat recently; started slowly at Sligo and did well to stay on and take third; went one place better at Clonmel; doubt raised by unplaced run at Wexford last time.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Well beaten in four outings this season, three of them handicaps; hard to make a case for her.

RaceName: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has run only once since second at Killarney in August 2022; yard has traditionally done well with veterans; nonetheless, likely to need this.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner who has had a fantastic run this year, winning his last four races on good to firm ground, over 6f and 5f; at the age of nine he seems to be closing in on his best-ever form and he has won off a slightly higher mark than today's in the past; Oisin Murphy up for the first time; much respected.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Has raced mostly at around 5f but there was no doubting that this C&D suited him well when he won by a wide margin (good to firm) in June; ran with great credit when eighth of 27 in the Stewards' Cup at Goodwood recently, after having to be switched, and looks a likely contender back here.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
OwnerName: Julie Martin & David R Martin & Partner
Spotlight: Had two C&D wins under his belt before finishing close up in the last two runnings of this (both on good to firm); not ideally placed when returned to this track in May but he should have a say again now back on a better mark, 3lb lower than last August.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Lost his way as a 3yo but he had smart 6f handicap form last May and a close second to Diligently over C&D (good to firm) in June signalled a return to better days; a Thirsk win at 6f and a close third over 5f at Ascot have followed and he can be in the thick of it.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Has plenty of handicapping experience but better than ever when winning quite convincingly over C&D (good to firm) recently; on a career-high mark against stronger opposition but it's not too late for him to do better.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Took advantage of a more favourable mark when winning over this C&D (good to firm) in June, a first win in Britain for over two years; perhaps downhill tracks weren't so helpful in two runs since, at 6f and 5f, but he still has something to find in this company.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins on AW; 0-9 on grass but cheekpieces seem to have bucked him up of late and he was very close to breaking his turf duck at Salisbury before making late inroads into Another Abbot's lead over this C&D last time; weighted to be thereabouts with that one and can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins over 5f; stays further, having finished better than anything when third of 21 in the Portland at Doncaster (extended 5f, good) last September but this is only his second run in a 6f turf handicap (faded in the first of them) so still has stamina to prove.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Four wins on extremes of going in 2025, including over C&D, but she surpassed them all in form terms when just losing out in a Listed race at Bath in April; had a rough ride from the handicapper as a result and she's found it all too much since; up against it.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in a Beverley maiden over two years ago but he only just failed to gain a first handicap win when touched off by Justcallmepete over C&D (good to firm) in May; some way below that level in Diligently's race here the following month, though, and others are higher up the list.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Has had some ups and downs in handicaps but is 2-3 in them over C&D (latest win when getting the better of Indian Run in June) and was seriously impeded in the other; has claims with Billy Loughnane up for the first time.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Just 3-26 on turf but this C&D does work well for him and he gained a deserved first win on the track when just fending off Uncle Don (good to firm) in May; has had going (good to soft) and trip (5f) excuses since but this company could be overwhelming.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple wins include two over 5f for new yard this year, the first under Myla Coppins and the second on this track; did win once over 6f back in 2022 but it's a long time since he played a part over this trip.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Smart on his day, as when runner-up to a top 6f handicapper at York (good) last October, and he saw off Desert Cop, Badri and Diligently in some style over C&D in May, despite being switched twice; not so good in two runs since but he's too talented to overlook back on this track.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: One turf win from 15 attempts, in a four-runner race at Chepstow (5f) last July; two fair C&D runs since returned to turf in May and was out on a limb when finishing sixth to Another Abbot and Sudden Flight 14 days ago; however, he'll do well to win at this level off his current mark.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
Spotlight: Saw out 2025 with three AW wins from his final four starts but he's played only minor roles in turf handicaps this year, including when beaten nearly 5l behind King Of Light over C&D in May; could do with some rain or, failing that, a return to the AW as he's well treated now.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner on heavy for former yard; inauspicious start for this stable when 100-1 and tailed off at Galway (16.5f, good); needs softer ground.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point-to-point winner; getting the hang of things over hurdles; fine effort in a Galway maiden on latest (2m6f, good); mark may be workable and interesting up in trip on handicap debut.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won this race in 2024 off this rating and fourth off 5lb higher last year; hinted that he may be returning to form in a handicap chase at Wexford on latest; could go well.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed promise in a couple of runs for Gearoid O'Loughlin but arguably best form has come on rain- softened ground; unproven over this far and probably best watched on first run for new trainer.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 1-21 over hurdles, the win coming at Thurles (2m4f, good) in November 2024 for Philip Rothwell; midfield at Kilbeggan on first run for this yard after a 232-day break so should be sharper now; now rated 2lb below his win and has run well here before; this trip is an unknown, however.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Limerick maiden hurdle in October (2m3f, gd-yld); best run since a 2.25l second of 15 here over 2m6f (good) on penultimate off 3lb lower; not as good at Sligo four days ago and has stamina to prove for this trip.

RaceName: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Not the easiest to win with, as her 2-30 record over hurdles illustrates; both wins at Sligo over 20.5f, but did run a cracker in this last year when beaten 4.25l into second and she's 5lb lower now; yard in form and she shaped well at Wexford on latest; big chance.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 10,000gns foal; first foal; by Sergei Prokofiev out of winner at 7f-8.6f (RPR 78), half-sister to multiple winner Fiscal Policy (5f/6f) and Dittander (5f 2yo); likely best watched on debut as yard has a better record in handicaps than at this level.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: All four runs over 7f with some signs of ability, albeit not looking to be crying out for the extra furlong despite several siblings having won at about this trip; still can't be written off in an ordinary race.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big prices when she finished last of five this summer over 1m at Ripon and 7f at Lingfield; likely to show more when qualified for run-of-the-mill handicaps.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promising debut third at Yarmouth (7f) for previous trainer and can't be entirely blamed for later defeats that year; two fair efforts for new yard, finding only a well-supported newcomer too good at Ripon (1m, good to firm) recently; looks competitive under Billy Loughnane, who's 1-4 for the yard.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; by Sea The Moon out of unraced half-sister to winners Furrion (useful Australian 6.5f-11.7f), Open The Red (1m2f; 83) and Elterwater (1m-1m2f; 81); interesting newcomer for in-form yard that has a healthy 14% strike-rate in maidens (11-78); market can guide.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 33-1 for two AW starts over 1m and 1m4f, finishing 20l and 30l behind the winner; heading for modest handicaps off a lowly mark after today.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Improved as a 2yo, running an eye-catching race when making late headway into fifth on Lingfield AW on final start (first three have done well in handicaps since); never able to threaten at Ffos Las (1m, good) only last week on her belated return but she should progress.

RaceName: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Never in the picture in two AW races at 1m (22-1) and about 1m1f (50-1); seems unlikely to suddenly sprout wings in a maiden.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Point winner made no impression on debut for this yard after a long absence in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last month; others preferred.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Very modest efforts in maiden hurdles at Limerick and Cork; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and rated just 82; beaten 49l off that mark in a handicap chase at Wexford on latest; difficult to make a case.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Both Sides Of The Water Syndicate
Spotlight: 0-6 in point-to-points but did go close in a couple of them; not beaten all that far in Downpatrick maiden hurdle on latest (2m6f, good) and that's amongst the best form on offer in this race; player.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Very modest form in point-to-points and under rules; beaten 19l off 82 in Wexford handicap chase on penultimate; was 22l behind when sixth in a Sligo maiden hurdle latest; cheekpieces worn that day left off now.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Far from disgraced on handicap debut at Wexford when last seen in May, beaten 8l off a mark of 102; a repeat of that back would give him every chance in this race.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-3 over hurdles and has had jumping issues; got around at Roscommon last time but was beaten 34l; needs more.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Failed to win a point and mid-field in both maiden hurdles, here and on latest at Galway when beaten 34l; given an RPR of 90 for that run, so place chance if he can build on it.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Point winner; stayed on well enough when sixth of 16 in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle (18.5f, good) in May; never sighted dropped back to 2m at Punchestown on latest; could do better now stepped up in distance.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: John P Coleman & M J Caffrey
Spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles and rated just 76; pulled up in a handicap chase at Killarney last month; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Huge odds and no show in bumper and two maiden hurdles; may need more time.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten a cumulative distance of 89l in a Leopardstown bumper and when 22-1 in a Downpatrick mares' maiden hurdle; with a top yard but her claims are not obvious; any market support could be significant.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Difficult to make a case for based on the evidence of heavy maiden hurdle defeats at Downpatrick and Limerick.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in a couple of points; struggled on rules debut at Naas in January (18.5f, heavy), but much better effort when mid-field at Galway (RPR 90) after a six-month break; could run into the money here if the new tongue-tie ekes out more.

RaceName: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Rated 98 after three runs over timber; her first two efforts at Tramore (2m, good) and Downpatrick (2m3f, good) saw her run to RPRs in the mid-90s; weakened over 20.5f at Bellewstown on latest, but bred to stay and Jack Kennedy takes over with a tongue-tie also added; chance.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed after only four starts, but absent since 21l defeat on handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW) in May; leap of faith required to support him.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Came good at seventh attempt, readily making all over C&D six weeks ago; that form has been well advertised by the clear runner-up since and this fellow could still be well handicapped after a 5lb rise.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Drops in grade after respectable third of six on recent handicap debut at Sandown (1m, good to firm; first-time hood), but displays an ungainly head carriage and needs to learn to settle better; others look safer.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Ran quite well from the front when upped to 1m at Kempton (AW) last month, but managed only sixth when favourite at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) three weeks ago; now 0-10 and needs to find something extra on this turf return.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Seemed to find things happening too quickly when dropped back to 6f for recent handicap debut, finishing only sixth of eight, but remains unexposed and his pedigree suggests this new trip will suit; cheekpieces removed but hood remains.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Still a maiden after six starts, but posted good effort when third at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month and looks well worth another crack at 1m; shortlisted.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Clearcut winner of Lingfield classified (7f, good to firm) under Oisin Murphy last month, her tenth start, and went very close off today's mark in recent handicap over that C&D; reunited with the champion jockey for this first attempt at 1m; must be considered.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Unplaced all five starts, most recently when well-held fifth on stable debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) three weeks ago; moves up in trip here; may yet come good for Richard Hughes but others have more obvious claims.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden who was behind Ingemar when well-held fourth of six at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who was safely held in Lingfield classified events on last two outings (7.6f/7f), latterly in race won by Creciente; needs significant improvement on handicap debut.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: C&D (good) maiden hurdle winner last August; form has nosedived since and beaten around 20l in handicaps in both starts this year; return to this venue needs to spark.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed ability in maidens and again when a 1.25l second over 20.5f (good) in a Killarney handicap hurdle on latest; should go well again off 3lb higher, but must prove stamina for this longer trip.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Bolted up over C&D (good) off 6lb lower when last sighted in May 2025; non-runner twice last month on account of good ground, so might need a drop of rain.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Course winner took a step back in the right direction at Kilbeggan on latest after four non-completions in a row; third of four, only beaten 5l, in Kilbeggan chase on Saturday.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran a fine race on handicap debut at Kilbeggan (24.5f, good), staying on well and finding just one too good; raised 4lb for that and cheekpieces go on; whether this sharper trip will suit is debateable, but can't be discounted.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Beaten 20l on handicap debut at Clonmel in February (16.5f, heavy) and was never travelling when pulled up over 20.5f at Down Royal when last seen in March; eased 2lb but best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time course winner (including over C&D); in the lead when overjumping and falling two out on her penultimate start at Clonmel; below-par here on latest but is on last winning mark and loves this place; not discounted.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Hasn't won since October 2024; bounced back from non-completions on first two runs for this yard with an encouraging third over C&D (good) last month; should be in the mix with a repeat of that.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-12 and hasn't looked like shedding the maiden tag in recent starts; tailed off at Sligo latest; others more convincing.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best maiden run came over 2m4f at Punchestown on nice ground; no impact over 2m on handicap bow on heavy at Navan when last seen in November; worth a market check moving up in trip on better ground.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden has been knocking on the door in recent starts; beaten 1l at Limerick (2m6f, soft) and a neck on latest at Roscommon (3m, good); nudged up 3lb, but this could be her day.

RaceName: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed little in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; hard to fancy on form.
